Lindsay Clancy didn't show 'break with reality' as jury weighs psychosis defense: Susan Smith prosecutor. The prosecutor who secured a conviction for Susan Smith says Lindsay Clancy's defense never proved a break with reality as jurors prepare to deliberate Thursday.

Florida driver fleeing traffic stop slams head-on into school bus carrying 19 children before fleeing on foot. Video captures Qahiem Williams allegedly fleeing a traffic stop and slamming head-on into a Florida school bus carrying 19 children before fleeing on foot.

PGA Tour Champions golfer Matt Gogel suspended six months for betting on PGA Tour events. Matt Gogel claimed he unknowingly placed small recreational golf betting wagers in 2024, resulting in a six-month PGA Tour Champions suspension.

TCU football pulls credentials from local newspaper for reporting on locker room assault story. TCU athletics rescinded the Fort Worth Star-Telegram's media credentials days before the Horned Frogs face Bill Belichick's North Carolina team in Dublin.

Backlash over Good Good Golf ad goes too far as stores pull merchandise, PGA Tour event potentially canceled. Good Good Golf faces massive fallout as Dick's Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy and PGA Tour Superstore pull merchandise from shelves over a controversial ad.

Armed man arrested at Trump golf course allegedly had first lady's schedule, notes on Secret Service: reports. Jeanine John Taele allegedly had Melania Trump's schedule and Secret Service personnel details among 208 pages of writings found in seven notebooks.

NYC business owners revolt over Mamdani’s government-run grocery stores: ‘Doomed for disaster'. Bodega owners rallied in Harlem to oppose Zohran Mamdani's city-run grocery stores, filing two lawsuits that allege civil rights violations.

Trump questions state of MLB while renewing push for Roger Clemens' Hall of Fame induction. Trump listed Roger Clemens' 354 wins and record seven Cy Young Awards on Truth Social, blasting baseball writers for keeping him out of Cooperstown.

NFL warns clubs they cannot sign any player who returns to college football for 2026 season, memo says. The NFL warned clubs that cut players returning to college cannot sign with a team this season, impacting LSU targets from the Browns and Saints.

ATF investigates ‘major’ cybersecurity incident as ransomware group claims attack. The ATF is investigating a cybersecurity incident designated a "major incident" by Justice Department officials as Qilin ransomware claims credit.

Hawley rips Flock’s sprawling surveillance web as Texas cities cut cameras over privacy and data fears. Texas cities are cutting ties with Flock Safety over data privacy concerns as Sen. Josh Hawley probes the company's 20 billion monthly vehicle scans.

Three-time Pro Bowl defensive end Za'Darius Smith stepped away last year after losing three family members. Za'Darius Smith said he was in a dark place after losing his mother, grandmother, and father before signing with the Atlanta Falcons for 2025.

'View' host Ana Navarro rejects Hunter Biden's assertion that Trump is 'already' a 'dictator'. Ana Navarro pushed back after Hunter Biden declared on her podcast that democracy was "gone" under President Donald Trump in contrast to some of her past comments.

HEAR IT: 911 call captures horrifying first moments of deadly shooting at Seattle’s Bite of Seattle festival. Newly obtained 911 calls reveal the chaos at the Bite of Seattle shooting, with dispatchers reporting six confirmed gunshot wounds near the Space Needle.

2026 TOUR Championship picks for East Lake: Why Chris Gotterup, Hideki Matsuyama and Russell Henley stand out. Chris Gotterup, Hideki Matsuyama, and Russell Henley headline outright and top-10 bets for the 2026 Tour Championship at East Lake Golf Club.

Why Meta's settlement could be an 'inflection point' for reining in Big Tech. 2026 has already brought a wave of setbacks for social media giants as pressure grows on Big Tech from regulators and lawmakers around the world.

FDA approves landmark pancreatic cancer drug that's shown to improve survival. U.S. health officials have approved a groundbreaking pancreatic cancer drug that offers a new approach to treating the deadly form of cancer, by blocking a protein that fuels tumor growth in the vast majority of cases.

Official leading Trump's Gaza ceasefire effort criticizes Israel for its attacks. The official in charge of President Trump's ceasefire plan for Gaza criticized Israel for its attacks on the Palestinian territory and warned that the alternative to the U.S. proposal is the next war.

Yayoi Kusama, high priestess of polka dots, has died. The Japanese artist has died at age 97. Kusama's polka dotted pumpkins, "Infinity Rooms," and other repetitive and dreamlike artworks have been shown in museums and galleries worldwide.

Drugstores say Medicare's $50 obesity drug program is catching on. The Bridge program, which began July 1, makes some Medicare beneficiaries eligible for obesity drugs for $50 a month. CVS and Walgreens say they've each already filled 100,000 such prescriptions.

Immigration arrests soar, hitting 50,000 in July. Since taking over in March, DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin has pivoted from the confrontational style of immigration enforcement of his predecessor, Kristi Noem. The latest data is reflective of a strategy that is working

Greetings from Karbala, Iraq, where millions gathered for a Shia pilgrimage. Pilgrims came to Iraq from all over the world in August. Many Iraqi and Iranian pilgrims walked hundreds of miles in extreme heat to mark the event. Outside the shrines, the atmosphere is almost festive.
States try new tactics to bring down high hospital prices. Indiana is the latest state to experiment with limiting what hospitals can charge, to try to get a handle on high health costs.

Judge clears the way for Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order for now. A federal judge in Boston canceled a nationwide ruling that blocked U.S. Postal Service work on President Trump's order to limit mail-in voting for the midterm election. But a new block may come soon.

Will Trump's latest beef plan make your hamburger cheaper? Not much, experts say. The proposal comes weeks before the midterm elections, when food prices and the cost of living are expected to be major issues on voters' minds.
